Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE transparent full-body pixel-art HUMAN character skin for a Japanese children's RPG.
Reference roles: image 1 is the approved 'ひだまりの旅びと' skin: match its actual pixel density, warm brown stair-stepped outline, simple rounded storybook face, 3-head-tall proportions and cheerful hand-authored personality. Image 2 is the user's own drawing: preserve its tender expressive eyes, rosy cheeks and warm approachable face in a fully HUMAN reinterpretation. Final 3 images are the game's canonical PIXEL DENSITY references only (pumpkin sword, mantle, charm): do not copy Halloween motifs.
Medium: real coarse pixel art composed on approximately 128x128 logical pixels, 24–32 colors, 1 logical pixel dark warm-brown outline and 3–4 FLAT shades per material. Deliberate chunky square clusters, visible crisp stair steps, no smooth curves, blur, painted gradients, microtexture or ornate tiny filigree. At larger output, it should look nearest-neighbor enlarged, not glossy high-resolution anime.
Composition: square 1:1, ONE character only, full body with feet/hair/weapon completely inside, 84% canvas height, comfortable alpha margin. Three-quarter front pose. Genuine alpha transparency, no backdrop/checkerboard/card/floor/ground shadow/aura. No text, labels, watermark or signature. No animal ears, muzzle, tail, companions or extra characters. Normal HUMAN ears/face/hands. Keep accessories few, shapes broad and readable.
Subject: original HUMAN girl mage called '花風のまほう使い' (do not render name), a companion matching the approved boy yet clearly a different silhouette. Round soft face, large warm chestnut oval eyes with simple highlights, rosy cheeks and a lively open smile. Fluffy chestnut bob hair with two short low outward bunches tied with small coral ribbons; ordinary human ears. Sage/mint green short hooded cape with a single large cream petal-shaped clasp, ivory long-sleeve blouse, dusty coral knee-length skirt over opaque cream leggings, soft brown ankle boots. One hand holds a simple warm wooden staff capped with ONE large five-petal cream flower with golden center; the other hand is raised cheerfully, palm open, rather than casting special effects. Modest cute practical outfit. Friendly confident standing pose with a slight lively lean. Dominant sage green, warm cream, dusty coral and brown; face gets room to breathe. No pointed witch hat, no fancy jewels, no floating sparkles.
